vibe: Underground electronic music culture, warehouse rave flyer aesthetic, brutalist, high-contrast, pirate radio.

fonts.purpose: Headings, massive visual text (hero, category names)
Body text, UI elements, metadata, buttons, stream keys

rules: Use ALL CAPS for section headings and small labels (tracking-[0.2em]).
No rounded, soft fonts. Typography must feel structural and mechanical.
Headings should have tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter).
Deep void black base. DO NOT use generic slate or blue-tinted grays.
Use Acid Yellow (#E5FF00) for primary CTAs and LIVE indicators.
Use Signal Red (#FF3B30) for destructive actions or recording states.

layouts.grids: Use visible grid borders (border-collapse look). Dense bento layouts for the broadcaster dashboard.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing for main sections (p-8, p-12), tight dense spacing for UI controls (p-2, p-4).
layouts.borders: Sharp corners. 0px border-radius globally (use rounded-none). 1px solid borders for structure.

components.buttons: Square edges, pure white or acid yellow background for primary, black text. High contrast hover states (invert colors).
components.inputs: Terminal style. Black background, 1px gray border, white text, sharp edges. Focus state: border-acid-yellow.
components.cards: Flat surfaces, no shadows. Use 1px borders to separate content. No glassmorphism.
components.player: Minimalist chrome. Just the video feed with a harsh 1px border. Use monospaced font for timestamps.

motion.hover: Instant or very fast (75ms) transitions. No slow, floaty animations.
motion.marquee: Use a marquee (react-fast-marquee) for categories or 'NOW PLAYING' text, brutalist style.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA compliance. High contrast is core to the aesthetic.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (sharp, technical) or lucide-react with stroke-width 1.5.
media.images: Use grainy, high-contrast, or black and white photography. Use CSS filters (grayscale, contrast-125) on thumbnails to match the aesthetic.

hero_background.description: Turntable and smoke, atmospheric rave vibe

broadcaster_avatar.description: B&W DJ hands mixing, perfect for default profile

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or Fontshare in index.html.
Do NOT use typical Shadcn rounded cards. Override radius to 0 in tailwind config.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural bento layouts, avoid generic Shadcn layout wrappers if they enforce rounding/shadows.
For the categories (music, drum and bass, dnb, house, tech, dubstep, reggae, acid, jungle, old skool), use a fast-moving, high-contrast Marquee or a strict grid of pills.
Ensure dark mode is locked/default. No light mode toggle needed for a warehouse rave app.
DO NOT apply generic 'transition-all'. Target transitions specifically (e.g., transition-colors).
Use Sonner for toasts, styled with brutalist black/white colors.
DO NOT center-align the main app layout. Use left-aligned, structured reading flows.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx
